policy: High and critical advisories fail. Moderate advisories may be temporarily baselined only with a reason, expiry, and follow-up.

allowed.name: @esbuild-kit/core-utils
allowed.reason: Dev-only transitive dependency of the latest drizzle-kit. It pulls esbuild 0.18.20 through deprecated @esbuild-kit/esm-loader; no fixed drizzle-kit release is available as of 2026-05-09.
allowed.followUp: Recheck drizzle-kit releases and remove this baseline when the package no longer depends on vulnerable esbuild.

allowed.name: @esbuild-kit/esm-loader
allowed.reason: Dev-only transitive dependency of the latest drizzle-kit. It is the path that brings in @esbuild-kit/core-utils and vulnerable esbuild.
allowed.followUp: Recheck drizzle-kit releases and remove this baseline when the package no longer depends on @esbuild-kit/esm-loader.

allowed.name: drizzle-kit
allowed.reason: Latest drizzle-kit 0.31.10 is still flagged because of its dev-only @esbuild-kit/esm-loader dependency. The npm suggested fix is an older major downgrade, not a safe remediation for the current Drizzle stack.
allowed.followUp: Recheck npm audit after each dependency update; do not downgrade drizzle-kit unless db generation/push compatibility is proven.

allowed.name: esbuild
allowed.reason: Only remaining vulnerable esbuild instance is nested under @esbuild-kit/core-utils for drizzle-kit CLI usage. App build/runtime uses patched esbuild through Vite.
